metadata.title: A generic $p$-Wasserstein space is isometrically rigid
metadata.abstract: We prove for any parameter $p \geq 1$ that the $p$-Wasserstein space $\mathcal{W}_p(X,d_X)$ of a generic compact metric space $(X,d_X)$ is isometrically rigid, that is, its isometries are precisely the push-forwards of the isometries of $(X,d_X).$ We also study the question whether the isometry class of a $p$-Wasserstein space completely determines the isometry class of the underlying space. We prove for any $p\geq 1$ that for a generic compact metric space $(X,d_X),$ its $p$-Wasserstein space $\mathcal{W}_p(X,d_X)$ is isometric to another $p$-Wasserstein space $\mathcal{W}_p(Y,d_Y)$ if and only if $(Y,d_Y)$ is isometric to $(X,d_X).$ En route we prove that a stronger property, which we call the Dirac preservation property, is also generic.
